newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone continues climb on subscriber news.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone continues climb on subscriber news.

text.p: Shares in mobile phone company Vodafone Plc advanced on Wednesday following upbeat news yesterday which included hitting the one million international subscribers landmark ahead of expectations.
The shares were indicated 5p higher at 266p by 0818 GMT in pre-market trade after adding 7-1/2p on Tuesday. The stock was just a penny short of matching its twelve-month high.
Others in the sector were also marked higher. Orange was up 2p at 200p whilst Cable & Wireless put on 4p to 491p.
Vodafone said in a statement on Tuesday that its share of subscribers connected to overseas networks had now passed the one million milestone.
When added to the UK subscriber base the group now has over 3.8 million subscribers of which over 25 percent have been added since the start of 1996.
"In 1996, for the first time, the Vodafone share of growth in net new international subscribers (486,000) was more than connected in the UK (468,000)," said Chris Gent, chief executive of Vodafone.

The Financial Times newspaper today highlighted the positive sentiment currently surrounding the shares. The newspaper said that the company's subscriber figures had surpassed most analysts expectations.
